title: xAI upgrades Imagine Video 1.5: New Image and Voice Reference Features, and Native 1080p Video Generation
excerpt: xAI has launched a major upgrade for its video generation model Imagine Video 1.5, adding image reference, voice reference, text-to-video generation, and native
content_html:
xAI has launched a major upgrade for its video generation model Imagine Video 1.5, adding image reference, voice reference, text-to-video generation, and native 1080p output capabilities, further enhancing role consistency, scene control, and video quality in AI video creation. Currently, the text-to-video and 1080p video generation features are available on the Grok Imagine web version, iOS, and Android apps. The image and voice reference features have been initially opened to SuperGrok Heavy and SuperGrok Plus users in the United States, with plans to expand to more users later.

This update provides users with a more flexible video generation process. Creators can directly generate videos through text descriptions, or upload reference images to control characters, products, or scenes. They can also combine character images with voice samples, allowing the AI to maintain consistent appearance and voice across different shots. xAI stated that Imagine Video 1.5 supports up to seven visual references per generation, used to fix facial features of characters, product characteristics, or environmental elements, thus achieving more precise content control.

In the multi-reference mode, users can retain character identity while replacing the background, keep the scene unchanged while changing the character, or adjust only the action while maintaining the overall visual setup. The voice reference feature further addresses the issue of character continuity in AI video production, ensuring stable facial features and voice performance for the same character across multiple segments.

For developers, the xAI API now supports calling image references, text-to-video generation, and native 1080p video generation capabilities through the grok-imagine-video-1.5 model. Developers can generate videos by passing parameters such as prompts, reference image URLs, video duration, aspect ratio, and resolution through the API. The voice reference feature requires integration via request methods.

Imagine Video 1.5 was released last month, and xAI stated that this version optimized motion performance, physical simulation, and audio generation. This upgrade further enhances the model's control over identity, scenes, and product details, making AI video generation gradually transition from simple image transitions to a multimodal creation tool closer to professional film production processes.

content_html_zh:
xAI对其视频生成模型Imagine Video 1.5进行了重大升级，增加了图像参考、语音参考、文本转视频生成和原生1080p输出功能，进一步增强AI视频创作中的角色一致性、场景控制和视频质量。 目前，Grok Imagine 网页版、iOS 和 Android 应用程序均提供文本转视频和 1080p 视频生成功能。 图像和语音参考功能已初步向美国的 SuperGrok Heavy 和 SuperGrok Plus 用户开放，并计划稍后扩展到更多用户。

此次更新为用户提供了更加灵活的视频生成流程。 创作者可以通过文字描述直接生成视频，也可以上传参考图片来控制角色、产品或场景。 他们还可以将角色图像与语音样本结合起来，使人工智能能够在不同的镜头中保持一致的外观和声音。 xAI表示，Imagine Video 1.5每代最多支持7个视觉参考，用于修复人物面部特征、产品特性或环境元素，从而实现更精准的内容控制。

在多参考模式下，用户可以在替换背景的同时保留角色身份，在改变角色的同时保持场景不变，或者在保持整体视觉设置的情况下仅调整动作。 语音参考功能进一步解决了AI视频制作中的人物连续性问题，保证同一人物在多个片段中的面部特征和语音表现稳定。

对于开发者来说，xAI API 现在支持通过 grok-imagine-video-1.5 模型调用图像引用、文本转视频生成以及原生 1080p 视频生成功能。 开发者可以通过API传递提示、参考图片URL、视频时长、宽高比、分辨率等参数来生成视频。 语音参考功能需要通过请求方法进行集成。

Imagine Video 1.5 于上个月发布，xAI 表示该版本优化了运动性能、物理模拟和音频生成。 此次升级进一步增强了模型对身份、场景、产品细节的掌控力，使得AI视频生成逐渐从简单的图像转场过渡到更接近专业电影制作流程的多模态创作工具。
